title: LIQUIDITY_POOL_DEPOSIT fails with LIQUIDITY_POOL_DEPOSIT_UNDERFUNDED
pattern: A transaction whose LIQUIDITY_POOL_DEPOSIT operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (underfunded). At the pool's 1:1 price the deposit needs 100 NRV; the account holds 1.

hazards.placement: deposit larger than the available balance at the pool price

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
